summary: EagleRock Land, LLC filed an 8-K to report a joinder agreement related to its existing credit facility in connection with its IPO closing. OpCo becomes parent/guarantor under the Predecessor Credit Facility, which had ~$263M outstanding. The facility bears interest at SOFR plus 8.0%-8.5%, matures July 3, 2027. Proceeds from the Offering will repay and terminate the facility. This is a routine capital structure update and IPO-related financing modification, not a special situation event.
